name: English
helpNote: Use your standard QWERTY keyboard layout. Keep your index fingers on F and J.

lessons.title: 1. Home Row Keys
lessons.description: Master the center row: A S D F G H J K L ;
practiceText: asdf jkl; asdf jkl; fdsa ;lkj fdsa ;lkj
dad sad lad fad ask flask fall hall salad
glas half dash lash shall جاگ flag glad had
ask a sad lad; a glad dad had aasha salad; fall glass

lessons.title: 2. Top Row Keys
lessons.description: Reach up to Q W E R T Y U I O P while anchored on the home row.
practiceText: qwer uiop qwer uiop trew poiu trew poiu
water power write quiet route towerilles outer
quoteetti pretty polite writer reportjaket
we write a quiet report; pour pure water into the pot

lessons.title: 3. Bottom Row Keys
lessons.description: Reach down to Z X C V B N M , . / with precision.
practiceText: zxcv bnm, zxcv bnm, vcxz ,mnb vcxz ,mnb
cabin music seven zebra brazooxen move
brave civicozzarella nimble vector bronze
seven nimble zebras move across the calm bronze valley.

lessons.title: 4. Numbers Row
lessons.description: Practice typing numbers 1 through 0 accurately without looking down.
practiceText: room 104 flight 782 page 395 score 98 order 450
on 12 may 2026 we counted 48 boxes and 390 books.

lessons.title: 5. Common Words
lessons.description: Build muscle memory for high-frequency English words.
practiceText: time person year way day thing man world life hand
part child eye woman place work week case point government
company number group problem fact people historynature
system program question work number night point home water

lessons.title: 6. Full Sentences
lessons.description: Type complete sentences with punctuation and rhythm.
practiceText: Consistent daily practice is the fastest way to improve your typing speed.
Keep your wrists relaxed and look at the screen instead of your keyboard.
Accuracy always comes first, and speed follows naturally over time.
